name: DYCD Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) Demographics and Services (Local Law 86)
description:
This dataset contains demographic and service-use information for youth served by New York City's Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) programs, reported under Local Law 86. Each row pairs a fiscal year (FY18 through FY26) with a demographic breakdown—such as age at enrollment, gender, race, or sexual orientation—and a specific category within that breakdown (for example, ages 16–17 or 18–20). For each combination, the data reports counts and percentages for two service settings: crisis services and transitional independent living (TIL) programs. A separate demographic grouping covers dispositions for youth who have exited a program.

The data can be used to track how the characteristics of youth entering RHY services shift over time, compare the populations served by crisis versus transitional living programs, and identify which age, gender, race, or orientation groups make up the largest shares of clients. It supports reporting and oversight of youth homelessness services, trend analysis across fiscal years, and equity-focused review
